principle: Consume the community's host-native standards and active content graph; own custody, qualification, semantic routing, household embodiment, and receipts.

commodities.name: Nexus Mods
commodities.role: primary packaged-mod distribution and holder-controlled acquisition
commodities.projectRoute: external acquisition only; record update key, manifest, version, and local hash; do not mirror without permission

commodities.name: ModDrop
commodities.role: alternate distribution and manager integration
commodities.projectRoute: external acquisition only

commodities.name: GitHub releases/source
commodities.role: open-source inspection, reproducible builds, issue and release provenance
commodities.projectRoute: prefer primary repositories; pin commit or release when source-backed

commodities.name: SMAPI
commodities.role: in-process loader, API/event host, compatibility rewriting, error containment, update checks, compatibility checks, daily save backup
commodities.projectRoute: authoritative host substrate; launch exact executable and profile; never replace

commodities.name: SMAPI manifest graph
commodities.role: UniqueID, version, EntryDll, ContentPackFor, dependencies, minimum versions, and update keys
commodities.projectRoute: machine-readable admission authority and profile identity

commodities.name: Pathoschild.Stardew.ModBuildConfig
commodities.role: cross-platform references, deployment, debugging, analyzer, and release packaging for SMAPI projects
commodities.projectRoute: official bridge build commodity

commodities.name: SMAPI APIs and events
commodities.role: lifecycle, input, game content, data, multiplayer, logging, reflection, translations, console commands, and mod integration
commodities.projectRoute: public API first

commodities.name: Harmony
commodities.role: runtime method patching when the host exposes no adequate public seam
commodities.projectRoute: version-bounded last resort behind an adapter; refuse unknown target versions

commodities.name: Content Patcher
commodities.role: conditional JSON changes to images, maps, dialogue, data, locations, items, shops, and other game assets
commodities.projectRoute: treat resolved host assets as world authority; do not translate packs into a private RODOH format

commodities.name: SMAPI content packs
commodities.role: framework-owned declarative content formats linked through ContentPackFor
commodities.projectRoute: preserve opaque pack structure and dependency host

commodities.name: Stardew Valley 1.6 native data model
commodities.role: native data-driven items, locations, machines, and trigger/query surfaces that supersede parts of older framework stacks
commodities.projectRoute: prefer native 1.6 plus Content Patcher when adequate; retain old framework only when the selected graph requires it

planes.policy: Discover through manifests and dependencies rather than hard-coding the entire community into the launcher.

representativeCommodities.name: Alternative Textures
representativeCommodities.role: texture variation for placeable objects, buildings, trees, animals, pets, plants, and related entities

representativeCommodities.name: Fashion Sense
representativeCommodities.role: extended and animated player appearance content

representativeCommodities.name: Farm Type Manager
representativeCommodities.role: map-local spawning of forage, debris, ores, monsters, and other farm-like features

representativeCommodities.name: SpaceCore
representativeCommodities.role: Content Patcher extensions, custom actions and queries, recipes, animation, spawnables, and dungeon support
representativeCommodities.statusNote: maintenance-mode component for Stardew 1.6; preserve only when selected content requires it

representativeCommodities.name: specialized Content Patcher extensions
representativeCommodities.role: storage, machines, terrain, notes, trinkets, visual effects, and other narrow content capabilities
representativeCommodities.projectRoute: consume selected dependencies; do not preinstall a maximal framework pile

commodities.name: Generic Mod Config Menu
commodities.role: in-game configuration for compatible mods and standard SMAPI keybind models
commodities.projectRoute: leave renderer and mod-specific settings here; MotionDeck owns only machine and profile custody

commodities.name: SMAPI KeybindList and ButtonsChanged
commodities.role: portable keyboard, mouse, and controller binding representation
commodities.projectRoute: bridge host bindings to semantic actions without suppressing native input

commodities.name: SMAPI --mods-path
commodities.role: select a concrete Mods tree at launch
commodities.projectRoute: authoritative profile launch boundary

commodities.name: Stardrop
commodities.role: open-source cross-platform manager with profiles, update checks, SMAPI integration, Nexus integration, import, and export
commodities.projectRoute: optional acquisition and human composition surface; Host Seam consumes the resulting selected graph

commodities.name: Vortex and ModDrop
commodities.role: existing acquisition and installation managers
commodities.projectRoute: optional upstream UX; never make their databases the sole local authority

commodities.name: dot-prefixed disabled folders
commodities.role: SMAPI-native manual disabling convention
commodities.projectRoute: ignore in active graph but record as disabled custody

commodities.name: SMAPI console and log
commodities.role: load decisions, compatibility warnings, errors, versions, and runtime diagnostics
commodities.projectRoute: capture with each execution receipt

commodities.name: SMAPI log parser and compatibility list
commodities.role: community-standard support and compatibility interpretation
commodities.projectRoute: link or API-consume where permitted; never replace with an ungrounded private compatibility score

commodities.name: Content Patcher debug, reload, and export commands
commodities.role: inspect resolved assets, hot-reload selected packs, and export post-patch content
commodities.projectRoute: use as evidence and adapter-development tooling

commodities.name: GingasVR.Stardew3D
commodities.role: 2D/desktop-3D/VR hot switching, procedural sprite/map presentation, world-space UI, wrist HUD, and motion controls
commodities.projectRoute: externally acquired presentation adapter; pin and wrap, do not vendor or rebuild

commodities.name: RODOH Stardew Host Bridge
commodities.role: lifecycle and semantic-presentation receipts plus future public adapter handshake
commodities.projectRoute: project-owned thin in-process bridge

commodities.name: MotionDeck cabinet-TV adapter
commodities.role: unworn-headset OpenXR tracking with authored monoscopic television output
commodities.projectRoute: project-owned remaining presentation contribution; version-bound to renderer handshake

commodities.name: Stardew Valley Expanded
commodities.role: large content and map compatibility corpus

commodities.name: Ridgeside Village
commodities.role: large content and map compatibility corpus

commodities.name: East Scarp

commodities.name: Clear Glasses

commodities.name: native save round-trip
commodities.role: prove presentation profile can be disabled without losing save authority

routingRules: Use the selected local manifest graph as live truth.
Use upstream managers for acquisition and human curation when useful, but recompute local custody independently.
Prefer Stardew 1.6 native data and Content Patcher over obsolete framework layers when the content allows it.
Preserve framework-specific content packs as opaque host-owned content.
Use public SMAPI and mod APIs first; isolate Harmony or reflection behind exact-version adapters.
Never redistribute holder-controlled packages merely because they are installed locally.
Qualify exact profiles and versions; never infer all-mod compatibility.
Keep native 2D available as an in-session fallback rather than treating fallback as product failure.
